  WHY: G3 requires the one alert per head to name the blocker, and the `ai-review/verdict-wait-alert` marker posted after the send stops any corrected alert. Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated it MAJOR; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT. The suggested fix is to pass `verdict_wait_reason` as an optional 4th argument and force the kind to `checks` when it is `auto_merge_waiting`.
- scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh:500-520 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `review_sweep_verdict_wait_alert` sends the Telegram alert before it posts the head-bound `ai-review/verdict-wait-alert` status marker, so if every marker POST fails the head stays unmarked and the next sweep tick sends the alert again.
  WHY: This breaks G3's "once per head, not once per tick", and tests/test_review_sweep_verdict_wait.py::test_failed_marker_post_is_logged_and_retried_next_tick (lines 379-394) pins the repeat. Reviewers disagree on whether to report it: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash left it out on purpose, as a send-then-mark residual accepted in an earlier round (iss_1d7820adc2071b44). All three reviewers who flagged it rated it MAJOR.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:958-963, 995 with scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh:441, 479 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The train-off fallback skips a head as `auto_merge_waiting` because nothing removes the stale `ai:final-ci-merge-pending` label. The alert still picks kind `final_ci` from that label and reports "final CI queued or running", and it never calls `_pr_ruleset_required_check_blockers` (the #9984 case, `ci/final (missing)`).
  WHY: With `MERGE_TRAIN_ENABLED=false`, the only Telegram WARNING sent after `VERDICT_WAIT_ALERT_HOURS` names the wrong blocker, and the marker stops a corrected alert. G3 requires the alert to name the blocker. Hardening fix: add an optional 4th argument `vwa_reason="${4:-}"`, force `vwa_label=checks` when it is `auto_merge_waiting`, and pass `"${verdict_wait_reason}"` at line 995 (3-4 lines, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1).
- Not re-reported: the marker POST failure that repeats the alert (send-then-mark was accepted earlier, iss_1d7820adc2071b44, and the marker POST goes through `gh_retry`). Also not re-reported: the per-PR stall GraphQL reads that are not batched (deferred under the issue's §15 fallback clause).

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh: `review_sweep_verdict_wait_alert` marker POST block (`for vwa_try in 1 2 3`); tests/test_review_sweep_verdict_wait.py::test_failed_marker_post_is_logged_and_retried_next_tick | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: If the marker POST keeps failing after a delivered Telegram send, the head stays unmarked, so the next tick sees `verdict_wait_alerted=false` and sends the alert again. The tightened test asserts `outcome=sent` on the second tick after `status_post_fails`.
  WHY: With `gh_retry` there is one POST attempt; without it there are three tries with 1s/2s sleeps, and nothing persistent is written. The alert can repeat every 30 minutes, which breaks G3's once-per-head rule, even though the trade-off is recorded in CONSOLIDATOR_OVERRIDDEN. Hardening fix: add a fallback PR comment marker (`<!-- ai:verdict-wait-alert:v1 pr=<n> head=<sha> -->`) checked via `comments(first: 1)` (~8 lines, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3).
- scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh: `review_sweep_verdict_wait_alert` jq `$kind` derivation and the `case "${vwa_label}" in final_ci) vwa_blocker="final CI queued or running" ;;` branch | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A train-off head that is labelled `ai:final-ci-merge-pending`, has auto-merge on and is MERGEABLE reaches the alert with the stale label, so it is reported as `final_ci`. `_pr_ruleset_required_check_blockers` is never called, so the real blocker (`ci/final (missing)`) is not read.
  WHY: G3 says the alert "names the blocker", so the operator is sent down the wrong path. No test covers this; `test_lease_waiter_alert_names_the_lease_holder` and `test_alert_once_after_the_wait_time_names_the_missing_check` cover only the lease and checks paths. Hardening fix: pass `"${verdict_wait_reason:-}"` as the 4th argument and force `$kind` to `checks` when it is `auto_merge_waiting` (~6 lines, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1).
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh (review_sweep_verdict_wait_alert), lines 441 and 479, interacting with .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml lines 957-963 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: With the merge train off, a labelled head kept skipped by auto-merge is alerted as "final CI queued or running". In this path `approved_final_ci` is success or none: an in-flight run would give `final_ci_in_flight` and a failure `approved_head_final_ci_failed`. The real blocker is the auto-merge / a missing required check, and the stale `ai:final-ci-merge-pending` label drives the wrong text.
  WHY: G3 requires the once-per-head alert to name the real blocker, and the marker posted after the send means no corrected alert follows. Hardening fix: pass `verdict_wait_reason` as an optional 4th argument (call site .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:1000) and force kind `checks` when it is `auto_merge_waiting` (3-4 lines, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1).
- Not re-flagged: the marker failure that repeats the alert, an accepted residual design ("send first, then mark").
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE (G1-G6 reported as all present in the diff)
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
